title: Solidity and EVM
summary: Use standard Solidity tooling together with Arbitrum-specific examples and compatibility guidance.

links.description: Run official samples for deposits, withdrawals, retryables, aliasing, gas estimation, force inclusion, and local nodes.
Use audited reusable Solidity contracts while pinning a release and checking proxy storage compatibility before upgrades.

title: Stylus Rust
summary: Build EVM-interoperable Rust contracts with pinned SDK versions, realistic tests, and explicit security checks.

links.description: Learn Stylus storage layout, entrypoints, calls, events, inheritance limits, reentrancy behavior, and ABI export.
Use the canonical Rust SDK, cargo-stylus tooling, TestVM support, macros, and maintained examples.
Optionally reuse audited Rust components after verifying its pinned Stylus SDK and nightly Rust requirements against the project.
Write fast TestVM unit tests with controlled storage, calls, sender, value, time, and chain context.
Apply deterministic-build, authorization, arithmetic, external-call, reentrancy, and denial-of-service safeguards.
